verdict.rationale: Fireworks docs explicitly market itself as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI's chat-completions API, with same SFT data format, OpenAI-compatible tool-calling specs, and querying text models via OpenAI-compatible APIs — enabling agents to switch providers by just changing the base URL. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of seamless mid-workflow switching and no OpenAPI spec found to verify full parity beyond docs claims.
